reconstruction.method: Restored predecision Cache/UAV slices from the saved observation; rebuilt formal forecast, popularity, horizon-mask and time fields from the same realization prediction artifacts. No policy, environment action, teacher or counterfactual branch was run.

history.source: prediction.vehicle.horizon=5; prediction.history_length_slots is not defined in this checkout
history.popularity_shift_uses_previous_boundary: t-H-1 through t-1, all strictly before t

context_definition.mobility_source_and_online_semantics: Only vehicle_predictions.csv horizon=0 x_pred/y_pred at past origins t-H..t-1; derives speed from adjacent past estimates. Does not use trajectory.csv ground truth or x_true/y_true, nor current/future-origin predictions.
context_definition.task_history_source: tasks.csv fields arrival, service_id, input_size, cpu_cycles at past slots only
context_definition.popularity_history_source: popularity.csv/popularity_history.csv rho_obs at past formal slots only

model.target: DELTA_EXPECTED / fold-train robust scale; 1.4826*MAD, fallback std

model_names.SR: normalized 400D + Group A + Group B + Group D
model_names.SRC: normalized 400D + Group A + Group B + Group C + Group D
model_names.CONTEXT_ONLY: normalized full context only; diagnostic baseline

high_confidence_classification.labels: EXPECTED_LABEL != UNCERTAIN; regression prediction >0 UPDATE, otherwise KEEP

decision.context_only_interpretation: diagnostic only; not a policy model
decision.next_step: 进入 recurrent latent context / Meta-RL probe。
